requires.description: Minimum Sumi version as a semver range, e.g. ">=0.4.0".

themeOverrides.description: Figure-wide refinements of the selected built-in theme. Omitted fields preserve the theme.

nodeCorners.description: Square node/group frames, including expanded matrix/tokens cells and legends. Intrinsically curved shapes are preserved.

edgeCorners.description: Sharp structured wires, including hidden junctions/forks, with butt caps and miter joins. Editable PPTX wires use flat caps and miter joins in both connector modes.

groupLabelWeight.description: Weight of group headings, overriding the theme's group variants.

fit.description: scale: shrink the whole figure (layout unchanged) to the profile's maximum width if it is wider; text is then checked at its printed size. Omitted means the figure is printed at its natural size.

engine.description: auto: D2/ELK. structured: arrange trees and attach. Omitted means structured if arrange is given, else auto.

direction.description: Flow direction of the root layout (auto engine only).

arrange.description: Structured layout: places the root-level nodes and groups.

align.description: Structured layout: elements of different arrange trees placed on one horizontal (y) or vertical (x) line.

fanIn.description: Edges from different elements entering the same point of an element without an anchor: merge joins them into one line, spread enters them side by side in the order of their other ends. Omitted means merge (structured layout only).

density.description: compact: the profile's tighter default gap, group padding and node padding, for dense paper figures (usually with fit: scale); gaps written in the figure stay as written. Omitted means normal (structured layout only).

label.description: Plain text; newlines break lines. Empty or omitted means no label.

labelAt.description: Where the label sits inside the group's border. Omitted means top (top centre) in structured layout and top-left in auto layout.

caption.description: Text drawn centred below the group's border, e.g. "(a) encoder". Drawn as a label with the reserved ID <id>-caption.

tone.description: Color category from the theme's palette (e.g. a pastel fill in the color theme, a gray step in monochrome themes). With variant outlined it colors the outline and text instead of the fill. Omitted means none.

dim.description: Draw the group and everything inside it (nodes, edges between them, nested groups, the caption, legends) in the theme's pale dim colors: gray text and lines, paler fills. Keeps the group's variant and tone; inherited and cannot be turned off inside. Omit it to draw the group as it is.

group.description: Parent group ID. Omitted means the root (or, in structured layout, the group whose arrange lists it).

arrange.description: Structured layout: places the group's children; listed elements become its children.

grow.description: Structured layout: relative weight of extra main-axis space under the immediate row/stack's justify: stretch (0 < grow <= 1000, default 1), apportioned in whole 0.5pt increments, not a final-size ratio. No effect without extra space, under other justification modes, in grid or attach, or on explicit main-axis sizes and non-stretchable shapes. Does not inherit. Rejected on expanded tokens, matrix and legend components.

label.description: Plain text; newlines break lines. Empty or omitted means no label.

sublabel.description: Structured layout: a second, smaller text under the label, e.g. a size "32 × 32 × 4" under "Noise". Drawn at 7/8 of the label's font size (rounded down to 0.5pt); newlines break lines and label math is allowed. Needs a label.

textAlign.description: Horizontal alignment of the node's label and sublabel within their shared text block (structured only). Omitted means center.

labelRotation.description: Structured layout: draw the label turned by 90 (clockwise, reading top to bottom) or -90 degrees (counter-clockwise, reading bottom to top), e.g. a title along a tall box. The node is sized to the turned label.

icon.description: A bundled icon drawn in place of the label, e.g. tabler/wave-sine (text color) or emoji/fire (original multicolour palette).

badge.description: A one-em corner badge, independent of the node label; its overhang reserves layout space.

icon.description: Bundled icon, e.g. emoji/fire or emoji/snowflake.

corner.description: Corner of the node's bounding box on which the badge is centered.

tone.description: Color category from the theme's palette (e.g. a pastel fill in the color theme, a gray step in monochrome themes). With variant outlined it colors the outline and text instead of the fill. Omitted means none.

mono.description: Draw the node's label and sublabel in the theme's monospace font (e.g. a class name or a prompt). false turns off a variant's monospace text. Math stays in the math fonts; \textcolor spans keep their colors. On a tokens node it is the default of its cells. Omitted means the variant's own setting (normally proportional text).

props.description: Component props, validated against the component manifest.

group.description: Containing group ID. Omitted means the root (or, in structured layout, the group whose arrange lists it).

attach.description: Structured layout: place this node beside another element instead of in an arrange tree.

to.description: The node or group to place this node beside, or a cell of a tokens node as <node>.<cell>.

side.description: The side or corner of the target to place this node on; a corner separates the boxes by gap on both axes.

gap.description: Space between the target and this node. Omitted means 0.

id.description: Optional edge ID (separate ID space from nodes and groups).

from.description: Source node or group ID, or a cell of a tokens node as <node>.<cell>.

fromAnchor.description: Where the edge leaves the source (structured layout only).

to.description: Target node or group ID, or a cell of a tokens node as <node>.<cell>.

toAnchor.description: Where the edge enters the target (structured layout only).

label.description: Plain text; newlines break lines. Empty or omitted means no label.

labelAt.description: Where along the route the label sits: beside the first segment (start), the longest segment (middle) or the last segment (end). Omitted means next to the arrowhead, or the middle of a line without arrowheads (structured layout only).

labelSide.description: Which side of the line the label sits on, facing from the source to the target. Omitted means above a horizontal segment and right of a vertical one, or the other side when that is clear (structured layout only).

tone.description: Color category from the theme's palette for the line, its arrowheads and its label (the tone's line color, e.g. a dark orange in the color theme, a gray step in monochrome themes). Omitted means none.

props.description: Component props, validated against the component manifest.

gap.description: Space between items. Omitted means the theme/profile default.

align.description: Cross-axis alignment of the items. Omitted inherits from an enclosing box on the same axis.

justify.description: Extra main-axis space: center (default), stretch resizable items by grow weights (default 1) in whole 0.5pt increments, or space-between items. Does not inherit or act at natural size; explicit sizes and fixed-aspect shapes are preserved. Sub-unit remainder stays as centered padding.

items.description: Node or group IDs, or nested stack / row boxes.

gap.description: Space between items. Omitted means the theme/profile default.

align.description: Cross-axis alignment of the items. Omitted inherits from an enclosing box on the same axis.

justify.description: Extra main-axis space: center (default), stretch resizable items by grow weights (default 1) in whole 0.5pt increments, or space-between items. Does not inherit or act at natural size; explicit sizes and fixed-aspect shapes are preserved. Sub-unit remainder stays as centered padding.

items.description: Node or group IDs, or nested stack / row boxes.

columns.description: Number of columns; items fill left to right, top to bottom.

rowGap.description: A length with a unit (mm, cm, in or pt), e.g. "3mm"; 0 needs no unit.

columnGap.description: A length with a unit (mm, cm, in or pt), e.g. "3mm"; 0 needs no unit.

ArrangeBox.description: A stack (vertical), row (horizontal), or row-major grid of items.

x.description: Node or group IDs (or tokens cells as <node>.<cell>) whose x (center, left or right edge) is made equal.

y.description: Node or group IDs (or tokens cells as <node>.<cell>) whose y (center, top or bottom edge) is made equal.

at.description: Which coordinate: center (default), start (top / left) or end (bottom / right).

AlignConstraint.description: Elements of any arrange trees placed on one line (structured layout only).
